authorizes: stage 3, leg 1 only; leg 2 keeps its own declarations in the contract

endpoints_unchanged_from_the_contract.co_primary: fibroblast activation score COL1A1, ACTA2, POSTN, CTHRC1, TNC, 5 of 5 present
endpoints_unchanged_from_the_contract.scoring: mean over members of log2(count / the well's human total * 1e6 + 1), the same prior and denominator convention A10 used
endpoints_unchanged_from_the_contract.co_primary_role: must agree in direction; the primary carries the decision

reference_set.primary: all wells of the Areg well's own unit, [60, 60, 60, 60] per unit
reference_set.no_exclusion_in_the_primary: excluding wells changes the rank universe, so the primary keeps every well and the depth restrictions are declared sensitivities instead

covariates: log2 of the well's fibroblast total counts
adjustment.epithelial_count_fraction_definition: mouse total counts divided by the sum of mouse and human total counts, from the A10 library totals table
adjustment.clarification_of_the_contract: the contract said epithelial read fraction; this freeze fixes the count-based fraction, because it comes from the same counts the endpoint uses and is reproducible from a tracked table without re-deriving the species assignment
adjustment.method: within each unit, ordinary least squares of the endpoint on an intercept and the two covariates, across that unit's wells; the residual is the analysed quantity
adjustment.why: stage 1 found fibroblast depth spanning four orders of magnitude and all four Areg wells above their unit median, so the depth control is load-bearing rather than decorative; C51 is the precedent

primary_test.statistic: the ascending rank of the Areg well's residual among its unit's residuals, summed over the four units
primary_test.direction: one-sided lower, declared before any value is read
primary_test.decision_threshold: reject only if the rank sum is at or below 64 and the Areg well is below its unit median in at least 3 of 4 units
primary_test.what_a_rejection_means: the Areg well is exceptional among the perturbations in its own unit, in the declared direction; it is not a comparison against an unperturbed population, and it is conservative when other wells in the unit act on the same pathway

S1_depth_floor.definition: reference set restricted to wells with at least 100000 fibroblast counts
S1_depth_floor.why: a mean over 54 genes in a shallow well reports detection rather than programme state

S2_depth_matched.definition: reference set restricted to the 20 wells nearest the Areg well in log fibroblast depth within its unit, the Areg well included
S2_depth_matched.why: the Areg wells are systematically deeper than their units, so a depth-matched reference tests the result against that asymmetry directly

S3_unadjusted.definition: the same statistic on the raw endpoint, with no residualization

declared_sensitivities.requirement_for_a_supported_reading: the primary must clear its threshold and the effect must hold in direction in at least one of S1 and S2, because the depth asymmetry is known in advance

declared_diagnostic: the within-unit association between the endpoint and log fibroblast depth, reported next to the result; stage 1 reasoned that a depth artefact would push the score upward, which opposes the declared direction, and stage 3 must show whether that holds

across_plates: HBEGF, on plate 4, labelled weaker for that reason

dropped.ERBB4: not expressed in the perturbed compartment: 0.367 log2 CPM when not targeted and exactly zero when targeted, so there is no receptor to remove

low_abundance_flag.EGFR: 1.967 log2 CPM when not targeted, about 2.9 counts per million, so this contrast is weaker than Erbb2 or Erbb3

uninterpretable_wells.rule: a contrast whose well is below the floor is reported as uninterpretable, not as evidence either way

control_wells.reason: four of the eight plate-3 control wells hold fewer than 100000 fibroblast counts, so they do not define the unperturbed location on this plate

decision_rules_unchanged.supported: the primary clears its threshold and its consistency requirement, the co-primary agrees in direction, at least one depth sensitivity holds in direction, and the receptor contrasts do not show the same shift
decision_rules_unchanged.precise_absence: unavailable at this design, declared before any test
decision_rules_unchanged.descriptive_only: always, while preparation independence is unresolved

changes_from_the_contract.change: Erbb4 dropped from the discriminating set
changes_from_the_contract.reason: not expressed in the perturbed compartment: 0.367 log2 CPM when not targeted and exactly zero when targeted, so there is no receptor to remove
